s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive liver lesion in a patient with a history of plasma cell myeloma
salient_findings: 35 mm lesion in the right hepatic lobe with SUVmax of 6.1 on PET/CT
17 mm lesion in segment VI with moderately increased T2 signal and restricted diffusion on MRI
Lesion size decreased to 10 mm then enlarged to 57 × 46 mm over subsequent months
key_facts: 62-year-old woman with IgG kappa plasma cell myeloma
Previously treated with multiple chemotherapy regimens
Underwent two autologous stem-cell transplants
Received thalidomide maintenance and focal bone radiotherapy
Asymptomatic with stable vital signs
No hepatosplenomegaly on examination
Normal liver function tests
Lesion in the right hepatic lobe showed increased uptake on PET/CT
Lesion in segment VI showed moderately increased T2 signal and decreased T1 signal on MRI
Percutaneous liver biopsy planned to establish a definitive diagnosis
